themes.label: Commercial real estate credit cycle
themes.rationale: M&T carries a sizable CRE and office/multifamily loan book; asset quality and reserve levels move with CRE valuations, refinancing stress and occupancy trends across its Northeast/Mid-Atlantic footprint.

themes.label: Net interest margin sensitivity to policy rates
themes.rationale: As a deposit-funded regional bank, M&T's core earnings are highly sensitive to Fed rate moves, deposit repricing lags and yield curve shape, directly driving net interest income swings.

themes.label: Regional bank deposit competition and funding cost pressure
themes.rationale: Post-2023 deposit flight to money-market funds and large banks pressures M&T's funding costs and deposit mix, a structural force shared across mid-size regional banks.
